dipole_torque_resolution — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × matrix × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.dipole_torque_resolution(pts, u, sigma_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', coef: 'float', area: 'float', radius: 'float', trials: 'int' = 100, window=None, seed: 'int' = 0, form: 'str' = 'divergence') -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import tactorque; tactorque.dipole_torque_resolution(pts, u, sigma_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', coef: 'float', area: 'float', radius: 'float', trials: 'int' = 100, window=None, seed: 'int' = 0, form: 'str' = 'divergence') -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("dipole_torque_resolution"))

उपयोग

marker centroid का noise σ [px] displacements में जोड़कर dipole को trials बार फिर से निकालता है, और torque resolution σ_M = σ_D/|coef| [N·m] मापता है। return sigma_D (2,), sigma_M (2,), D0 (noise के बिना), snr = |D0|/σ_D, trials। σ_M ∝ σ (मापा गया)। Raises ValueError: σ < 0, trials < 2, coef = 0।
